entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-16
entry.content:

  • [NETSDKE2E]With NET 10.0.200 preview SDK installed, Some files are not identical in .exe installer and in .zip package. #52506

    11.0.1xx
